children: UAE-founded proptech and mortgage platform Huspy has acquired Italian credit intermediary Integra Finance as part of a strategy to build a leading mortgage finance and real estate business in Italy.
The financial terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
The transaction marks Huspy's entry into the Italian market and comes alongside plans to invest $86 million (AED315 million) in the country.
Huspy operates an AI-powered platform for real estate agents and mortgage brokers and is active across the UAE, Spain, Saudi Arabia and Italy.
"We are doubling down on Europe, and Italy is central to our next phase of growth," Jad Antoun, co-founder and CEO of Huspy, said in a statement.
Italy becomes the fourth market for Huspy, following the UAE, Spain and Saudi Arabia.
Since being founded in 2020, Huspy has raised around $200 million from international investors including Sequoia Capital, Balderton Capital, Founders Fund and Fifth Wall.

In 2026 and 2027, Huspy plans to focus on developing the Italian market, expanding to additional markets in Europe and the MENA region, and strengthening its presence in Spain, the UAE and Saudi Arabia.
(Writing by Brinda Darasha; editing by Daniel Luiz)

title: Dubai-based Huspy acquires Italy's Integra Finance, plans $86mln investment
